title: Identify logical sectors using the actual code and boundary matrices
statement: Two completed graph syndromes encode the logical classes,including measurement and final-readout faults.

evidence.quote: ## 2. The complete noisy-record problem becomes two positive sums
### No ideal final quantum decoder is needed for destructive readout

requires: One Pauli-error sector of a planar surface code encoding ONE logical qubit over a finite window of repeated noisy syndrome measurements. Independent binary graphlike fault mechanisms; contractible spacetime region with two distinct connected rough boundary components; known initialization or preparation faults included. Actual finite code/boundary matrices satisfy H_check=(B_H)_internal and im S_stabilizer=ker B_H,checked by the source-prescribed binary elimination on the actual supplied code. For unknown-rate calibration: stationary rates across independent repetitions of the SAME schedule,bounded detector degreeDelta,and promised fixed0<p_min<=p_e<=p_max<1/2. Calibration identifiability requires the stated unique interior-edge/separable boundary factors; no detector may hide distinct factors to both rough components,and parallel mechanisms merge only with the same detector incidence AND logical effect. A separated distance>=3 patch is the supplied sufficient example. External general nonnegative perfect-matching counting FPRAS has relative accuracy1+/-eta and worst-case polynomial bit time,includinglog(1/delta),as explicitly named in the source. Calibration/model promises do not certify arbitrary hardware noise.
provides: Collapse rough components separately to b0,b1. Verify H_check=(B_H)_internal and im S_stabilizer=ker B_H on supplied spatial code matrices. With data faults d_t and measurement faults m_t,syndrome differences are s_t=H_check*d_t+m_(t-1)+m_t mod2. The detection graph includes spatial and temporal edges.

The two classes are exactly B_G z=T_h=(s,h,|s|mod2 XOR h),h=0,1. XOR spatial faults over time and discard temporal edges; temporal incidences cancel. Same completed syndrome implies stabilizer-equivalent final data faults by the finite identities. Different boundary parity changes logical class. No homology oracle or arbitrary-topology extension is supplied.
Independent odds q_e=p_e/(1-p_e) give Z_h(s)=sum_(B_G z=T_h)product_e q_e^z_e and posterior Z_h/(Z0+Z1). Every compatible history appears once,including measurement-error loops/stabilizer degeneracy.

For destructive logicalZ readout,y=a+r and H_Z y=H_Z a+H_Z r. Independent readout flips are final DATA-error edges,affecting both derived checks and raw logical parity;derived check errors must not be treated as independent measurement faults. Classical parity correction uses established destructive-readout machinery and consumes the encoded state.
assumptions: Completed source-reported independent-graphlike reference case is not the selected full correlation-aware physical decoder. Local Pauli X/Z correlations and coupled spacetime joint class weights remain missing; a four-port obstruction excludes LOCAL nonnegative matching gadgets,not all global representations or a hardness theorem. No general matching FPRAS was implemented/benchmarked; polynomial existence and a large proof comparison constant do not establish useful decoder latency or practical advantage. Unknown-rate calibration is polynomial in p_min^-1 and inverse moment bounds,not merely rate-description bit length; fixed rate bounds and bounded degree matter. Destructive logical readout consumes the encoded state and provides classical output,not a coherent quantum decoder port. Arbitrary topology/many logical qubits,non-Pauli/coherent or nonstationary/misspecified hardware noise are outside the earned model. No new Capital/root scientific verification/audit,physical experiment,novelty/priority certification or completed civilisation-level capability is claimed. Source UI explanations and source-reported finite checks are not independent audits.
costs: Let m be fault mechanisms,Delta detector degree,a=(1-2p_max)^(2Delta). Source calibration uses K=O[m^2 Delta^2/(a^2 p_min^2 epsilon^2)*log(m/delta_cal)] INDEPENDENT schedule repetitions,each yieldingO(m) detector bits. For supplied rational rates,positive weighted matching reduces to unweighted usingO(logW_e) integer gadgets and denominator scaling,polynomial in rational input length. Counter complexity must include relative accuracy,graph/input length andlog(delta_counter^-1). Pay total failure delta_total<=epsilon*p_min^m/2 when both sectors feasible,so log delta_total^-1=O(m log p_min^-1+log epsilon^-1); no inverse rare-syndrome/logical-error enumeration factor is introduced by the proved weight/risk argument. The source cites a matching-proof comparison constant proportional to(10N)^80*r^9;that source-local r is not silently identified with code distance or fault rate. Calibration shots/data,all FPRAS work,rounding/precision,feasibility checks and actual decoder latency are paid; useful practical cost is not achieved.

Calibration repetitions and detector bits counted separately. Logical failure is a probability;FULL diamond distance has factor2,not half-diamond. Matching comparison r is source-local.
